About the school

Care that begins with understanding.

The Divine – Special School & Autism Care offers individualised education and developmental support for children with autism and other special needs in Haldwani.

Our trained team and sensory-friendly environment help each child build communication, learning and life skills, while we work closely with families every step of the way.
